_comment: Recall-quality fixture v1. Three short conversations + 7 probes covering employment+location, pet, dietary preferences, and a noise probe. Used by POST /admin/run_fixture to compute recall@1 / recall@3 / noise resistance / mean top-score. Per CLAUDE.md §7: 'Build this fixture early; run it after every change.' All user_ids must start with 'fix-' so the admin endpoint can reset them safely without touching real data.
name: recall-v1

messages.content: I just moved to Berlin from NYC last month. Loving it so far.
That's exciting! Berlin is a great city. How are you settling in?
I just started at Notion this week as a product manager. Left Stripe last month — needed a change after four years of engineering work.
Congrats on the new role! How are you finding PM work compared to engineering at Stripe?
We just adopted a dog yesterday — a beagle named Biscuit. He's three years old and already knows sit and stay.
Welcome to the family, Biscuit! Beagles are wonderful — how is he settling in?
Just got back from walking Biscuit in the park. Beautiful morning.
Sounds lovely. Beagles need a lot of exercise — daily walks help a lot.
I'm vegetarian and I'm allergic to shellfish. Also I don't drink coffee — caffeine wrecks my sleep.
Got it. I'll keep those constraints in mind for any food or restaurant suggestions.
